title: Allowance
summary: Open an owner vault, fund it, grant a session to an agent, and let that agent pay a listed merchant within per-request and daily caps.
what: Allowance is an Anchor 0.32.1 spending firewall for x402-style agent payments. init_vault creates a PDA (seeds ["vault", owner]) and its ATA. deposit/withdraw move tokens under the owner. create_session binds an agent key to caps and a merchant allow-list. agent_pay, signed by the session agent, pays a listed merchant from the vault ATA; unlisted merchants require 8004/ATOM reputation accounts.
app_note: The page at /dapps/allowance-solana/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/allowance-solana. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/allowance-solana/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran init_vault, deposit, create_session, a rejected over-cap agent_pay, a 1_000_000 listed-merchant payment, and withdraw.
try_steps.see: Program EMQ41VCu…. Vault HBqti9tX… should have a 0-token ATA after withdraw; merchant Gg25WLuS… received 1_000_000.
try_steps.ran: init_vault aUy7KApm…; deposit 2VP1LKUL…; create_session 47utkXeH…; over-cap rejected OverRequestCap; agent_pay 4yvW5qbW…; withdraw zePTz5pC…

diagram: owner --init_vault/deposit--> vault PDA+ATA; owner --create_session--> session(agent, caps, merchants); agent --agent_pay--> merchant ATA; owner --withdraw--> owner ATA.
innovation: Payments leave the vault only through agent_pay, which enforces per-request, daily, and per-merchant caps (or a one-time approved pending voucher) and optionally a 8004 reputation gate for unlisted merchants.
frontend: Generic IDL console at /dapps/allowance-solana/. Optional agent_pay accounts (registry, ATOM, pending) should be passed as the program id when unused.
exercises: Name the seeds of the vault and session PDAs.
objectives: Explain what an allowance account authorises.
Perform one allowance set or spend on Devnet.
Show how a spend beyond the limit is rejected (or cite recorded rejection).
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds.
Familiarity with signer vs owned accounts.
student_outcome: Set or use an allowance and verify spending limits on-chain (OverRequestCap).

learning_loop.objective: Inspect vault + session — then predict OverRequestCap when amount exceeds per_request_cap.
learning_loop.predict_question: A session agent requests a payment with amount greater than per_request_cap. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Payment succeeds for the capped amount automatically

learning_loop.predict_why: Allowance sessions enforce per_request_cap on-chain. Over-cap requests fail rather than silently paying a reduced amount.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/allowance-solana/ on Devnet. Prefer recorded init_vault → fund → grant session → pay proofs. Reproduce or explain OverRequestCap; name vault and session PDA seeds.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why should per_request_cap be enforced by the program rather than only by the agent client?
learning_loop.transfer: Name vault and session seeds, and one path not covered (unlisted-merchant / approve_pending).

assessment.purpose: Independent elective criteria; no Picassol leakage.
